Implemented all four actions in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), using only Node.js standard modules.

```sh
node output/main.js --input request.json --output response.json
```

Verified with 71 passing tests, ZIP interoperability checks, and 9,700 malformed-input checks.

See [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md) for details. Archives support stored/deflate and ZIP64, with a 256 MiB expanded-size limit; encrypted archives are unsupported.

editorial.last_message: Completed GEDCOM/GEDZIP implementation; unchanged source scores 212/212 under GEDCOM 4.0.3.
editorial.notes: The implementation uses Node standard modules only and implements all four GEDCOM/GEDZIP actions. Transcript evidence includes 71 final passing self-tests, 9,700 seeded malformed-input checks, Python ZIP interoperability, stored/deflate/streaming descriptor/ZIP64 cases, a 65,536-member archive, and deep-tree workflows. Initial generated-schema and self-test fixture issues were corrected before completion. Source performs public family-to-individual backlinks and explicitly exempts @VOID@ targets. The original 4.0.2 and isolated 4.0.3 grades are both 212/212, with identical outcomes for every common node. Its documented 256 MiB expanded-archive resource cap and unsupported encrypted archives should remain visible as implementation limitations; passing the suite is not an exhaustive conformance claim. Both generation and grading completed voluntarily, with no quota/authentication/disconnection interruption. Full transcript and authored implementation reviewed. Requested gpt-6-astra with max reasoning is corroborated by the session; served_model remains unknown/null. Launch used CLI 0.153.4 with hosted apps explicitly disabled and web search disabled. External-tool audit found no MCP, hosted-app or web-search invocations, with no verification problems. API-only proxy logs show only allowed chatgpt.com API access; nine denied non-API attempts did not gain access. Saved token, cache, reasoning and underlying-tool counts exactly match reparsed preserved events/session; no usage correction is required. Launch and completion revisions differ, but the audited invocation files are byte-identical. Original artifacts remain unchanged.  Official 4.0.3 regrade now confirms 212/212 and matches every isolated candidate outcome. The exact underlying-tool total remains 52. All token, cached-input and reasoning totals, generation cost and original metadata remain exact. Source, raw result, transcript, richer session and network artifacts are unchanged. No new model call or model cost was incurred. Actual generation comparison cohort: api-only-apps-disabled; apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed. Requested model/effort are corroborated by preserved session evidence; served identity remains unknown/null.
